name: Dana Webb
want: find the survivors worth the convoy's fuel and get them out before the herd arrives
secret: Her orders are to bring in only the healthy and the useful: the convoy can't take everyone, and she will be the one who chooses.
voice: Clipped radio habits, "copy that", calls everyone by their surname; softens with kids.
description: A National Guard scout from the rescue convoy, sent ahead from the checkpoint at the junction to see who is still alive in Harmon.
appearance: Dusty fatigues, a rifle slung across her chest, a radio on her shoulder and a face that hasn't slept in days.
